items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 40:1
items.html: Beriah is attributed to the Bina of Atzilut, because Ima nests in Beriah, for she has the Mochin of SAG from the upper AVI of Atzilut, which come out upon a screen of phase two, which are the discernment of the Mochin of the GAR of Ima, as is known. However, there is a great difference between the Mochin of SAG of Atzilut and the Mochin of SAG in Beriah, because the Mochin of SAG of the upper AVI in Atzilut, although they are covered Hassadim, nevertheless they can ascend to the GAR of AA and receive Hochma whenever they wish. But the Mochin of SAG in Beriah are discerned such that the Hassadim in them were separated from every discernment of Hochma, because the screen of phase two is included together with the Parsa beneath Atzilut, and no illumination of Hochma can pass with those Mochin to Beriah. Therefore this light of the Mochin of SAG is not discerned as a light of essence, but as a light of offshoot and a new creation, because a new matter was made in them, that the Hassadim were separated from the light of Hochma, which had never been so before. Therefore it is called Beriah, to indicate that it is a new creation. (Item 31).
